character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A friendly young farmer standing, wearing an earthy olive-green canvas jacket over a cream-colored sweater, brown work trousers, and durable leather boots. They have a thoughtful, welcoming expression, short hair, and a small utility satchel or belt pouch. Clean retro pixel art style, high contrast, crisp lines with a single color outline. Designed as a side-scrolling companion guide for an environmental data application.
